questions.question: What does Isaiah 16 urge regarding the fugitives of Moab?
options: Drive them back across the border
Hand them over to the enemy
Demand a heavy tribute from them

questions.question: On what basis would a throne be established in steadfast love?
options: One who builds up very high walls and very strong gates of bronze
One who is greatly feared by all of the surrounding nations
One who gathers to himself great armies and very great wealth
One who judges and seeks justice and is swift to do righteousness
questions.answer: One who judges and seeks justice and is swift to do righteousness

questions.question: Isaiah 16 mourns the loss of Moab's vineyards and joyful harvest.
We have heard of Moab's pomposity, his exceeding pride and _____.
A throne will be established in steadfast love, and on it will sit in faithfulness one who _____.
